serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Mrs. Fisher: WAKE UP YOU IDIOT! {{punch}}
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Oh no… {{wi}}He isn’t breathing…
Mrs. Fisher: I will have to do mouth-to-mouth…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.AngryClosed+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: Mmmmmww…
#mrsfisher.Eyes.Grin+mrsfisher.Mouth.Angry
You: {{punch}}STOP! {{wi}}I can breathe just fine!
That was a close one…
#mrsfisher.Face.Grin
Mrs. Fisher: Oh! You are alive! 
Mrs. Fisher: I had a bad feeling so I went looking for you. It would be a huge mess if they connected your death to me somehow.
You: Right…
#mrsfisher.Face.Angry
Mrs. Fisher: It doesn’t mean I’m not angry! What the hell were you thinking?!
You: Sorry about that…
Mrs. Fisher: You are banned from taking any drugs forever! {{wi}}And I will be confiscating your stash of course.
You: …
Mrs. Fisher: What is this? {{wi}}Huh? Czechoslovakian synthetic stuff? How did you get your hands on this thing? 
Mrs. Fisher: You are one lucky man, you know that? Not many people survive taking this to tell the tale.
Mrs. Fisher: Now go home. I’m very angry at you.
You: Sure…
